tools.name: commercials_profile
tools.description: The track record of a brand, director, agency, production company, DP, editor or composer in FrameThrower's ads library: how many spots, which years, who they work with (clients, agencies, directors, production companies), awards by show, typical tones and genres, their best and most recent work — and, for directors / agencies / production companies with a public page, the researched profile (description, founded, HQ, website).

kind.description: brand, director, agency, production, dp, editor, edit_house, post, music, sound or vfx

tools.name: commercials_stats
tools.description: Count and rank the ads library: how many commercials match a filter, broken down by any of brand, director, agency, production, dp, editor, music, industry, market, year, genre, structure, format, tone, trope, award_show, season. E.g. "which agencies won the most Cannes Lions for car ads since 2015" = fields [agency], award_show Cannes Lions, industry Auto, year_min 2015.

tools.name: find_by_craft
tools.description: Find frames by specific cinematography craft attributes — lens character, shot size, visual style, setting, time of day, director, or year range. All optional; combine to narrow. Use this to refine a search precisely.

tools.name: find_similar
tools.description: Find frames visually/semantically similar to a given frame id (from a prior result). Use this to pull more references like one the user shortlisted.

tools.name: get_commercial
tools.description: The full breakdown of one commercial by id: idea, logline, tagline, product, audience, every credit by role (director, agency, production company, DP, editor, music, post, sound, VFX), every award (show, year, level, category), craft numbers (shots, average shot length, cuts per minute, when the product / brand / emotional peak / end card land), the script with timings, and the shot list (caption, tags, still and clip per shot).

tools.name: get_frame_details
tools.description: Get the full metadata + preview thumbnail + full-resolution image URL + depth map URL + link for a single frame id. The depth map is precomputed and free — use it when the user is generating images and needs the composition or camera geometry of this frame.

tools.name: search_commercial_shots
tools.description: Find individual SHOTS inside commercials by what is in the frame ("hand pouring beer in slow motion", "car drifting at night in the rain", "family laughing at a kitchen table"), with shot tags (size, angle, setting, time of day, lighting, mood, people, product / logo visible) and any commercial-level filter (brand, director, agency, award show, year…). Each shot has its still, a short clip of just that shot, its tags and a link to the exact moment.

tools.name: search_commercials
tools.description: Find whole COMMERCIALS (TV / online spots) in FrameThrower's ads library by idea, story or brief ("two rival neighbours outdo each other at Christmas", "a product demo told as a heist") and/or by facts: brand, director, agency, production company, DP, editor, award show and level, year, industry, market, tone, genre, structure, season. Without a query it lists matching spots, award winners first. Returns each spot with brand, title, year, credits, best award, logline, a still and a link to watch it.

tools.name: search_frames
tools.description: Search the FrameThrower cinematography reference library by concept, mood, color, composition, or scene. Returns reference frames with film/credits metadata, a preview thumbnail, the full-resolution image URL (use this one for slide decks and documents), a precomputed DEPTH MAP url (greyscale, same dimensions as the frame — pass it straight to a depth ControlNet or any image-to-image pipeline that wants geometry), and a link to view on FrameThrower.
